Signal filters work correctly but return 0 items for HIGH/MEDIUM because existing items were processed before AI prompt update (expected behavior).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23 tested Phase 3 of Cross-Border Watch. Key features: 1) grouped array in response with category/label/items structure, 2) cross_border_category on all items via keyword fallback, 3) feedback_boosted field for rated items (currently no items have ratings), 4) Frontend shows category groups with icons (Handshake=diplomatic, Swords=defence, Landmark=internal_politics, BarChart=economics), 5) Items numbered sequentially within each country section.
